notes.title: Monster Girl Jungle Introduction
notes.content:
It’s been a few days—hope you’re all doing great and still enjoying My Life in a Monster Girl Paradise!

First off, huge thanks to everyone who's supported the project by buying the game. It seriously means a lot and keeps me motivated to make more games and bring fun experiences to all of you.

If you’re enjoying the full release and it’s hit your fancy, I’d really appreciate it if you left a review and maybe share it around if you know someone who would like a this type of game!

Now, about what’s next—I want to give you all a little introduction to my next project.
[list]
[*] Note:Some part of the decorations are outdated since i already updated a lot of aspecto of the next game, I will probably share some images about it soon in the game page.
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3557720/Monster_Girl_Jungle/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44813025/c49f44fe5ae7d1be5734ce02d52381e7132890c7.png[/img]
Explore the jungle, meet its intriguing inhabitants, manage your hunger to stay safe, and form a unique bond with a playful monster girl.
[list]
[*] It’s basically a visual novel with some light sandbox elements and simple stat management to give players a bit more interaction alongside the story.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44813025/e147b5776a176b0e95e2e83321908183a9796cbc.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Zelra is a lamia girl with a twisted personality. She often uses hypnosis to weaken her prey, luring them into a state of bliss as her long snake tail slowly coils around them.
[*] ?
[*] ?
[*] ?
[/list]
[list]
[*] (There are 4 monster girls planned in total, but right now only one is ready.)
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44813025/90b2858c74e538a02cb6a90636e086f3a486a5a9.png[/img]
A monster girl delights in using her unique quirks to captivate the main protagonist, like Zelra, who often relies on hypnosis to gain the upper hand.
[list]
[*] Each girl will have her own distinct "kinks" and scenarios to keep things fresh and varied. For example, Zelra features hypnosis and vore content. (Don’t worry—if vore’s not your thing, the game gives you the option to skip that kind of content!)
[/list]
Note:
[list]
[*] The game demo is already available to try out! Just a heads-up—I recommend lowering the volume a bit before playing, as some sounds can come through pretty loud depending on whether you're using speakers or headphones.
[*] This will be more balanced in the full release, which will also come with an updated demo featuring improved writing—especially in the player's background story.
[/list]

notes.title: My Life In A Monster Girl Paradise Final Update Announcement
notes.content:
The final release of the project was published on 2025.05.01, marking the game's official completion. While some minor bug fixes may still be necessary, all game content is finalized.

The final version of the game contains 125,868 words and 90 H-scenes.

Changelog:
28 HScenes.
Vaginal content.
Pregnancy content.
Kid NPC for decoration.
12000+ Words.
100 achievements added. (Steam only)

Translations:
English—Default Language
French
German
Japanese
Korean
Portugal
Russian
Chinese
Spanish
Italian

Performence improvements.
Player stat increased.
Required leveling exp reduced.
Cheat added.
Gallery added.
You can skip text now using ctrl.
Writing correction.
Bug fixes.

tags.feature: You can skip text now using ctrl.

notes.title: My Life In A Monster Girl Paradise 1.5 Changelog
notes.content:
Changelog
- 4 Hscene (Bath/Kitchen-Harpy + Succubus).
- New Main Menu Screen/Thumbnail

Gama received the last kitchen/bath update, which means the following update will be the vaginal/pregnancy content.
The planned update time is 2 months, but delays are possible depending on the progress, and unexpected situations can happen.
Achievements and translations will be included.

The page will receive a new trailer, decorations, and screenshots of the game this month.

notes.title: My Life In A Monster Girl Paradise 1.4 Changelog
notes.content:
Changelog
- 4 Hscene (Bath/Kitchen-Goblin + Slime).
- New Battle-Fuck UI
- Improved Textbox UI
The UI change overall should improve the display and readability for everybody who had such an issue before.
- Game optimized for people with weaker PCs
This means everything will reset once you leave the area, so you don't need to wait until the next day.
With this change, the game performance should improve and give the players an easier resource collection time.
But of course this means extra danger since the monster girls will reset as well.
This change not only includes quests or dating variables but also most parts of the reset script were resource/girl-related.

tags.feature: - Game optimized for people with weaker PCs

notes.title: My Life In A Monster Girl Paradise 1.2 Release/Changelog
notes.content:
Changelog

- 4 Hscene (Bath/Kitchen-Scylla + Eel).

- 2300+ words.

- Marriage System Updated: No more divorce; you can build a harem.

- Player House has a third floor; you can access it once you are married (big enough to keep 14 wives).

- 1 Event.

- If you have a quest for material collecting (forest), now you will get the dialogue that tells you you got the item.

- Lot of bug fixes and improvements.

Note: Fun fact, but the game dialogue word count soon will pass 85000.

notes.title: My Life In A Monster Girl Paradise 300+ Sales / Some News
notes.content:
My Life In A Monster Girl Paradise passed 300+ sales, for which I'm thankful for everyone.
Also, if not too much trouble, I wish people who bought the game to leave a review sharing their experience and what could be improved in the future or what would be nice to add.
But the review itself will do a huge amount of help for me in keeping the game from being lost on Steam due to small reviews.

As for the news, I share a short version of what kind of stuff can be expected for the next month's update.

- New Hscenes.
- Quest Board, so you can check out what kind of quests you accepted.
- Events.
- Bugfixes.

tags.feature: - Quest Board, so you can check out what kind of quests you accepted.
